display.purpose: Section headers, card/lote/team titles, modal headings; masthead date uses an italic variant of the same family.

label.purpose: Uppercase 'classified column-head' voice: nav, tabs, buttons, badges, form labels, kanban headers.

mono.purpose: Any figure that must align: prices, codes, dates, phone, CPF, stat-row big numbers.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting cards, ruled-sheet grid containers, mobile menu button.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Modals, login card, mobile sidebar drawer — the only lifted surfaces in the system.

motion.name: ease-fast
motion.purpose: Default state transition for nav items, buttons, tabs, hover fills.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Single responsive breakpoint: off-canvas sidebar, stacked stat row, single-column grids/forms, horizontal table scroll.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button (e.g. Save in a modal footer).

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1.5px solid #7a7461; background-color: transparent; color: #1b1912; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #dcdbd2; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5a2a6b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge (static)
components.description: Hand-stamped status mark; rotated -2deg; border-style carries meaning (shown: dashed 'em andamento').
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; border: 1.5px solid; line-height: 1.5; transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-status-doing { background-color: rgba(90, 42, 107, 0.1); color: #5a2a6b; border-style: dashed; border-color: #5a2a6b; }

components.name: Status Badge — Late (double border)
components.description: Terminal/alarm state; double 3px border distinguishes it from ordinary dashed/solid states.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; border: 1.5px solid; line-height: 1.5; transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-status-late { background-color: rgba(139, 58, 43, 0.12); color: #8b3a2b; border-style: double; border-width: 3px; border-color: #8b3a2b; padding: 2px 9px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field with accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-form-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-form-label { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #5c564a; } .ds-form-input { padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid #7a7461; font-size: 0.9rem; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; color: #1b1912; background-color: #f1f0ea; caret-color: #5a2a6b; } .ds-form-input::placeholder { color: #615a4c; } .ds-form-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #5a2a6b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #5a2a6b; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation link; active state fills solid ink, not the accent color.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 3px; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; border: none; background: transparent; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #5c564a; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background-color: #dcdbd2; color: #1b1912; } .ds-nav-item-active { background-color: #1b1912; color: #faf9f5; }

components.css: .ds-sheet-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); background-color: #f1f0ea; border-top: 1px solid #c7c2b6; border-left: 1px solid #c7c2b6; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,25,18,0.1); overflow: hidden; } .ds-lote-card { border-right: 1px solid #c7c2b6; border-bottom: 1px solid #c7c2b6; transition: background-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-lote-card:hover { background-color: #faf9f5; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #5a2a6b; } .ds-lote-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 16px; background-color: #dcdbd2; border-bottom: 1px solid #c7c2b6; } .ds-lote-body { padding: 18px 16px; } .ds-lote-codigo { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.76rem; color: #5c564a; } .ds-lote-title { font-family: 'Bitter', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1b1912; } .ds-mono { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.76rem; } .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; border: 1.5px solid; transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-status-leilao { background-color: rgba(122,92,26,0.12); color: #7a5c1a; border-style: dashed; border-color: #7a5c1a; }

narrative.northStar: Seção de Editais (the auction-classifieds page of a Brazilian newspaper)
narrative.overview: Agiliza Leilões reads as a printed page of legal notices, not a SaaS control panel: a light, slightly warm newsprint ground, near-black ink for text, a single stamp-colored accent, and structure built from ruled hairlines rather than floating boxed cards. Every record — a lote, a lead, a task, a visit — behaves like a published notice: nothing disappears, it gets carimbado (stamped) with a new status. Density is real (a tabular stat row, a numbered task column, ruled sheets of lotes and team members) but never cramped; whitespace comes from rhythm and rule lines, not from padding-heavy cards. This is a full-identity replacement, not a reskin. The previous system — a near-black '23.4studios' dashboard with a blue accent, pill-shaped buttons, and Archivo/Fragment Mono type — was explicitly disavowed by the user as belonging to a different business and is treated purely as anti-reference. The flip from dark to light is a deliberate scene judgment (newsprint reads as a daylight, paper material) and the move away from pill radii is a deliberate rejection of 'rounded SaaS' language.
keyCharacteristics: Light newsprint ground (#E4E3DD) with near-black ink (#1B1912), never dark mode.
One identity accent — carimbo roxo, ink-stamp violet (#5A2A6B) — kept separate from a distinct five-color semantic/status palette.
Status is a mark, not only a hue: border-style (solid/dashed/double) carries semantic weight alongside color.
Grid surfaces (Lotes, Equipe, Kanban) are one ruled sheet with hairline-divided cells, never independent floating shadowed cards.
Sharp, small corner radii (3-4px) everywhere except true circles (avatars, WhatsApp button); no pill buttons.
Four-family type system: Bitter (serif display), Barlow (body), Barlow Condensed (uppercase 'classified column-head' labels), JetBrains Mono (tabular figures).

rules.name: The Two-Palette Rule
rules.body: The carimbo-roxo accent (identity, interaction, emphasis) and the five-color status palette (task/lote/lead/visit state) are separate systems. Don't recruit a status color for a UI accent role, and don't extend the accent into new status meanings beyond the existing 'doing' reuse.

rules.name: The Masthead Distinction Rule
rules.body: `.masthead-date` (italic Bitter, 1.15rem, own 2px ink underline) is a separate role from `.card-title` (Barlow Condensed, uppercase, 0.82rem label). It is the paper's own nameplate for 'today's edition' on the Dashboard and must never collapse into a generic card title.

rules.name: The Ruled-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Lotes, Equipe, and Kanban are one bordered/shadowed/radiused container; individual cells inside contribute only border-right/border-bottom hairlines — no per-item radius, no per-item shadow, no hover-translateY. This was a finish-review-mandated correction after an earlier draft left independent floating cards in place; reintroducing per-item box-shadow + radius + lift in these contexts is the specific defect this system rejects.

rules.name: The Flat Nesting Rule
rules.body: A card/row nested inside another surface (a lead row inside a lote card, a task row inside a team card) is a plain ruled row (border-bottom only, no background box, no shadow) — the ruled-sheet logic applies recursively to nested content, not just top-level grids.

dos: Do use the carimbo-roxo accent (#5a2a6b) sparingly — active nav underline, primary buttons, focus rings, the one price highlight — never as a general-purpose background fill.
Do pair status color with border-style (solid/dashed/double) whenever adding a new status value; color alone is not sufficient in this system.
Do keep new grid/list surfaces on the ruled-sheet pattern: one outer bordered/shadowed container, hairline-only per-item borders, flat-tint + inset-ring hover.
Do use JetBrains Mono for any new tabular/numeric field (prices, codes, dates, phone, CPF) to match the existing figures.
Do reference public/logo-agiliza-ink.png (dark navy ink mark) for any new brand-mark placement; its navy tone is a fixed, separate brand asset and is intentionally not tied to the violet UI accent.
donts: Don't reintroduce dark mode as a default surface; the flip to a light newsprint ground was a deliberate world decision, not an oversight.
Don't reintroduce pill-shaped (--radius-full) buttons, badges, tabs, or inputs; --radius-full is reserved for true circles only (avatars, WhatsApp button).

Don't add box-shadow + border-radius + hover-translateY to individual items inside a grid/list (lote cards, team cards, kanban cards, nested rows) — this is the specific defect the finish review already caught and corrected once.
Don't apply the -2deg status-badge rotation to any interactive control (select, button); rotation is reserved for static <span> badges only.
Don't reference public/logo-agiliza.png (the old light-on-transparent mark); it is orphaned since the light-mode flip and would be invisible on the current background — use logo-agiliza-ink.png.
Don't use display: block on a <table> to make it scroll on mobile; wrap it in .table-scroll (overflow-x: auto on the container) instead — the block approach previously broke column layout.
Don't treat document/contract-generation UI as designed; no visual treatment exists yet for that unscoped future feature.
